content.title: It Is Because You Stand With Us That We Find the Courage to Continue This Unequal Fight!
content.subtitle: So, in this battle to preserve our faith, we have a small request for you.
content.body:
The digital world is no longer just a technological tool. It has become a carefully designed trap that threatens the purity of our eyes, the innocence of our children, and the faith of the entire Ummah. The moment we unlock our phones, countless temptations await us. A single careless click can lead us into darkness.

Against this overwhelming tide, our dream of providing future generations with a safe and halal digital environment seemed almost impossible. Yet you have stood beside us from the very beginning. Your unwavering trust, moral encouragement, and financial support have inspired us to keep moving forward. Because you are with us, even our small team has the courage to stand firm against this immense fitnah. May Rabbul Alamin reward you abundantly. Ameen.

The Relentless Effort Behind the Scenes

Keeping these platforms running around the clock for millions of people is no easy task. Our engineering, support, marketing, and operations teams work tirelessly behind the scenes. Alongside their efforts, we face substantial server maintenance costs, regular technical expenses, and the challenges of managing daily operations. Yet, our workforce remains very limited compared to the enormous scope of our responsibilities.

A Commitment Greater Than Personal Comfort

Since our team is small, our brothers hardly get a day off. They have consistently prioritized this responsibility and trust over personal leisure, family time, and weekly rest. They are not driven by worldly fame or material gain. Their motivation comes from a single commitment: to honor the sacred trust you have placed in us and protect future generations from the dangers of the digital world.

The Reward That Makes Us Forget Our Exhaustion

Whenever we read messages in our inbox or reviews on the Play Store and App Store, our hearts fill with emotion.

When parents express their relief at being able to protect their innocent children from harmful online content through Kahf, or when a brother shares how Allah guided him back to the right path through our platform after he had drifted away from his faith, we feel deeply moved. We are equally touched when families tell us that they follow the app's schedules together, observe the Ayyam al-Bid fasts, and make their homes more spiritually enriching through regular morning and evening adhkar and Quran recitation. At such moments, tears of gratitude come to our eyes. We feel that our hard work and sacrifices have been worthwhile.

Our Humble Request to You

You have always supported us with love and sincerity. Today, with that same sense of closeness, we have one special request: Please remember us in your duas more often.

We know you already pray for us, but we ask you to continue. Dua is a divine blessing through which Allah can change a person's destiny. At this time of widespread fitnah, we need His help more than ever.

After your obligatory prayers, following Quran recitation, or while standing alone before your Lord during the quiet hours of Tahajjud, please remember us. Even as you read these words, take a moment to make dua for us.

May Allah keep our intentions free from showing off and arrogance. May He grant us the strength to remain steadfast in our mission and vision despite every obstacle. And may He allow this service, established to protect the Ummah, to continue until the Day of Judgment. Ameen.
